# Third-party build scripts

Build scripts and version pins for native dependencies that are too large or too slow to build
in every CI run. Their prebuilt artifacts are published as versioned GitHub Release assets.

| Dependency | Milestone |
|---|---|
| OpenCASCADE | [M0.2](../docs/roadmap/phase-0-foundation.md) |
| PlaneGCS | M1.4 (decided in ADR-0005) |

Notices for everything that ships with the app are collected in
[THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
